source: github.com/vmware/vcf-api-specs (vcf-operations-openapi.json / realtime-metrics-openapi.json, 9.1.0.0); cross-checked against the family verified-endpoint spec (VCF Operations 9.1, section B).
note: Seeded to guard vmware-aria's new VCF Operations 9.1 Fleet/Findings/PromQL read tools against 踩坑 #36 (a prior skill shipped hallucinated endpoints, half of which 404'd). Every ops call under vmware_aria/ops/fleet.py and promql.py must resolve to one of these paths. suite-api paths carry base '/suite-api' and are validated by the whole-tree conformance test alongside the vROps 8.6 index; the data-query-service path is on a separate base and Bearer JWT, and its base prefix is INFERRED from the Swagger UI location (verify against a live appliance).

operations.description: Query certificate status/expiry across the fleet. Returns certificate records (subject/issuer/validTo/status/thumbprint).
Query managed password-account status across the fleet. Returns accounts (username/resource/status/expiry).
List the SDDC/workload domains behind one registered VCF integration.
Query diagnostic findings with filters (severities/categories/findingTypes). Returns findings (ruleUuid/severity/category/affectedObjectsCount).
List registered integration services. Used to locate the VCF_VODAP service and its serviceKeys for the PromQL token exchange (hop 1 of 2).
Exchange the acquired OpsToken for a service-scoped Bearer JWT given a serviceKeys payload (hop 2 of 2 for PromQL/VODAP).

PromQL instant query against the real-time (VODAP) metrics service. Prometheus-standard response shape. Requires the exchanged Bearer JWT, NOT the OpsToken header. The '/data-query-service' base prefix is INFERRED from the Swagger UI location and must be confirmed against a live appliance.
